isbn_note: Read directly off the book's own colophon page (pdf_page ~215 of catalogues-pdf_catalogue-latvia.pdf), confirmed 2026-07-18. collection_holder_note: Private collection, not a public institutional anchor — each artist contributed one 10x12 cm work made specifically for the Imago Mundi collection (a small number of artists contributed two). Record as holder, do not overclaim as a museum/public anchor.
